abstract: Investors increasingly turn to social media for information, even though many sites are saturated with ideological opinions. This paper examines whether ideology-driven social media opinions affect stock market responses to polarizing firm news, using boycotts as the empirical setting. On average, polarizing boycotts are associated with a 1% (2.3%) drop in equity value over the seven (60) trading days after gaining social media traction. Consistent with ideology-driven opinions affecting market responses, the immediate price reaction is more negative when users ideologically aligned with boycotters dominate social media, particularly when their opinions are visible and financially relevant. A mediation analysis suggests that this association operates indirectly through overall social media sentiment toward the boycotted firms. Additionally, trading volume and daily return volatility following boycotts are positively associated with user ideological diversity. Together, these results suggest that ideology-driven social media opinions could influence how investors respond to polarizing firm news.
abstract_zh: 投资者日益转向社交媒体获取信息，尽管许多平台充斥着意识形态观点。本文以抵制活动为实证背景，考察意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点是否影响股市对极化企业新闻的反应。平均而言，在获得社交媒体关注后的七（六十）个交易日内，极化抵制事件与股权价值下降1%（2.3%）相关。与意识形态驱动的观点影响市场反应相一致的是，当与抵制者意识形态一致的用户主导社交媒体时，即时价格反应更为负面，尤其是在这些观点可见且具有财务相关性的情况下。中介分析表明，这种关联通过社交媒体对受抵制企业的整体情绪间接发挥作用。此外，抵制事件后的交易量和日回报波动性与用户意识形态多样性呈正相关。综合来看，这些结果表明，意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点可能影响投资者对极化企业新闻的响应方式。
title: Ideology-driven social media opinions and capital markets: Evidence from polarizing boycotts
title_zh: 意识形态驱动的社交媒体舆论与资本市场：来自两极分化抵制运动的证据

abstract: Few mafia traditions have endured as long or been shared as widely as the pizzo . The pizzo was and is a customary payment collected from clients by Italian mafias in exchange for private protection. The value of the pizzo was vulnerable to two sources of dissipation. First, excess competition for clients from other mafiosi . Second, evasive behavior from clients themselves. I argue that Italian mafias created de facto property rights to limit those losses. To limit competition, mafias in Italy defined client ownership via territorial delineation. To limit opportunism by clients, mafias tailored pizzo terms in proportion to clients’ latitude for opportunism. Historical evidence from New York mafias and Italy’s retailing and construction industries supports my thesis.
abstract_zh: 很少有黑手党传统能像“保护费”（pizzo）那样持久且广泛流传。保护费过去是、现在依然是意大利黑手党向客户收取的、以换取私人保护的惯例性费用。保护费的价值面临两种损耗来源：其一，其他黑手党成员对客户的过度竞争；其二，客户自身的规避行为。本文认为，意大利黑手党通过创设事实上的产权来限制这些损失。为限制竞争，意大利黑手党通过地域划分界定客户所有权；为限制客户的投机行为，黑手党根据客户投机行为的空间量身定制保护费条款。来自纽约黑手党以及意大利零售业与建筑业的历史证据支持了本文论点。
title: Organized thuggery
title_zh: 有组织的暴行

abstract: We estimate the global price of credit risk from a large cross section of global corporate bond returns. We show that a single factor, constructed as a nonlinear function of past credit spreads, equity market volatility, and their interactions, prices bond returns in both the time series and the cross section. The factor significantly outperforms alternative measures of global financial conditions, explaining up to 13% of variation in bond-level three-month-ahead returns. A high global price of credit risk further translates into deteriorations in local credit conditions, outflows from global funds, and higher expected returns to global funds.
abstract_zh: 本文研究金融状况如何影响专注于绿色创新的企业的研发活动。通过将美国专利数据与Compustat数据库匹配，我们将“绿色创新者”定义为绿色专利累计占比高的企业。尽管这些企业在绿色专利总量中占比很小，但它们处于绿色创新生态系统的核心位置。通过估算企业层面对外生广义金融状况变化的脉冲响应，我们发现金融紧缩对专业化绿色创新企业的研发产生了不成比例的大幅且持续的负面效应。相比之下，多元化创新者和非创新者的研发反应较弱。绿色创新者通常更年轻、规模更小且更依赖外部融资，这表明金融紧缩对上游绿色技术发展引入了系统性偏见。
title: The Global Credit Cycle

abstract: Many economic and financial series exhibit non-stationarity as well as long-memory behavior in both the first and second moments. To capture both non-stationarity and long-memory characteristics simultaneously, a general dual-trend and dual longmemory framework is proposed. In this framework, the error term of the semiparametric FARIMA model is assumed to exhibit a slowly changing scale and longmemory heteroskedasticity. A four-step estimation procedure is proposed, including a trend and a FARIMA model estimation for the first moment, followed by a scaling function and a long-memory volatility model estimation for the second moment. Three long-memory EGARCH-type models and the FIGARCH model are employed in the final stage. Our results indicate that the proposed approach can effectively model the selected economic series exhibiting dual-trend and dual long-memory features.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个广义市场因子（BMF），用以代表美国经济中所有企业（包括上市公司与非上市公司）的价值加权股权回报。BMF与标准价值加权市场因子（VMF）存在差异，后者仅反映上市公司的价值加权股权回报。我们将VMF与BMF之间的差值定义为特质金融因子（IFF）。IFF不包含风险溢价，且与我们考虑的所有投资者边际效用宏观经济代理变量均不相关。对于大多数投资组合而言，若以VMF而非BMF为基准进行测算，CAPM贝塔值及相应的贴现率将被低估。在标准因子模型中，若以BMF替代VMF，规模因子将变得冗余，规模异象亦随之消除。当以BMF替代VMF时，跨期风险-收益关系显著增强。这些结果的统一解释在于：IFF为VMF增添了非定价风险，从而扭曲了横截面与时间序列上对定价市场风险暴露程度的估计。
title: Dual-trend and dual long-memory time series modelling

abstract: We estimate the environmentally adjusted productivity growth and shadow price for Ontario dairy farms. We use an input‐oriented directional distance function and farm‐level data from 2000 to 2020. First, we find that while GHG emissions per cow increase with higher milk yields, emission intensity decreases as milk yield per cow increases. We also find that emission intensity decreased over the study period. Second, we find that environmentally adjusted productivity growth is higher than unadjusted productivity growth. Technological change contributed more to both environmentally adjusted and unadjusted productivity growth than did efficiency change. Third, the estimated shadow price for GHG emissions was CAN$286 per metric ton.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了安大略省奶牛场的环境调整后生产率增长及影子价格。我们采用投入导向型方向性距离函数，并使用2000年至2020年的农场层面数据。首先，我们发现尽管每头奶牛的温室气体排放量随牛奶产量的提高而增加，但排放强度却随着每头奶牛产奶量的增加而下降。同时，我们还发现研究期间排放强度有所降低。其次，我们发现环境调整后的生产率增长高于未调整的生产率增长。技术进步对两种生产率增长的贡献均大于效率变化。第三，估算的温室气体排放影子价格为每公吨286加元。
title: Environmentally adjusted productivity growth and shadow prices for dairy farms
title_zh: 环境调整后的生产率增长与奶牛场影子价格

abstract: Abstract Supply management (SM) has recently attracted a lot of attention nationally and internationally. A bill (C‐202) to safeguard SM from future international trade negotiations was voted unanimously by the Canadian parliament in 2025. At the international level, tariffs associated with SM have been criticized by the Trump administration. Given that SM is based on a tacit social contract between SM farmers and society at large, as well as its political significance, it appears important to assess the level of knowledge of Canadians regarding this policy, as well as their perception of SM themes raised in the media. This paper reports the literacy score and perceptions on SM of a national survey of over 1200 respondents. To analyze the data, perceptions on SM themes are regressed on respondents’ level of SM literacy, sociodemographic data, as well as on two questions that are of a more ideological nature. Results indicate that Canadians have little knowledge of the working or scope of SM. Furthermore, after providing neutral information on themes related to SM that are or have been in the media, we find that the views toward SM policy are mostly negative, with the most negative perceptions held by respondents with ideologies that we loosely classify as economic conservatism.
abstract_zh: 摘要 供应管理（SM）近年来在国内和国际上引起了广泛关注。一项旨在保护供应管理免受未来国际贸易谈判影响的法案（C-202）于2025年在加拿大议会获得一致通过。在国际层面，与供应管理相关的关税受到了特朗普政府的批评。鉴于供应管理基于供应管理农民与整个社会之间的一种隐性社会契约，以及其政治重要性，评估加拿大人对该政策的了解程度以及他们对媒体中提及的供应管理议题的看法显得尤为重要。本文报告了一项全国性调查中超过1200名受访者的供应管理素养得分及其看法。为分析数据，我们将受访者对供应管理议题的看法回归于其供应管理素养水平、社会人口统计数据以及两个更具意识形态性质的问题。结果表明，加拿大人对供应管理的运作方式或范围知之甚少。此外，在提供关于媒体中已出现或正在出现的供应管理相关议题的中立信息后，我们发现对供应管理政策的看法大多为负面，其中持有我们粗略归类为经济保守主义意识形态的受访者所持看法最为负面。
title: Level of knowledge and perceptions of Canadians on supply management
title_zh: 加拿大民众对供应管理的认知水平与看法

abstract: Abstract True dietary change typically occurs through consumer preferences, and when changes in product attributes reflect these preferences, category‐level demand can be substantially rearranged. In this study, we show that a successful new product may fundamentally change the nature of an entire category, and change consumers' nutrient consumption by altering the nutrient content of the food products they consume. Greek yogurt, for example, offers a very different combination of nutrients relative to other types of yogurts. The fact that it was immediately successful after its introduction provides an example of a transformational new product—one that potentially changed the nutrient‐consumption profiles of yogurt buyers. We use a quasi‐experimental approach with propensity score matching (DiD + PSM) to identify the effect of introducing Greek yogurt on yogurt buyers’ nutrient consumption. We find that the introduction of Greek yogurt led to yogurt purchases with greater overall protein and calorie content, but lower fat and carbohydrate content. We use the case of Greek yogurt to show that a relatively simple innovative common consumer product can have far‐reaching implications for the nature of nutrients consumed from that category. Our findings point to the importance of information policies, and their interaction with consumer preferences, on changing dietary outcomes.
abstract_zh: 真正的饮食变化通常源于消费者偏好的转变，当产品属性的变化反映出这些偏好时，类别层面的需求可能会发生显著重组。本研究表明，一款成功的新产品可能从根本上改变整个类别的性质，并通过改变消费者所消费食品的营养成分来影响其营养摄入。例如，希腊酸奶相较于其他类型的酸奶，提供了截然不同的营养组合。其上市后迅速取得成功，成为变革性新产品的典范——这类产品可能改变了酸奶购买者的营养摄入结构。我们采用准实验方法，结合倾向得分匹配（双重差分法+倾向得分匹配法，DiD+PSM），以识别希腊酸奶引入对酸奶购买者营养摄入的影响。研究发现，希腊酸奶的引入导致酸奶购买中总蛋白质和热量含量增加，而脂肪和碳水化合物含量降低。我们以希腊酸奶为例，说明一个相对简单的创新性大众消费品可能对该类别中摄入的营养成分性质产生深远影响。我们的研究结果强调了信息政策及其与消费者偏好相互作用在改变饮食结果方面的重要性。
title: The effect of new‐product introduction on nutrition consumption: The case of Greek yogurt
title_zh: 新产品引入对营养消费的影响：以希腊酸奶为例

abstract: This paper studies optimal monetary policy in a two-country Schumpeterian growth model incorporating the spirit of capitalism (SOC). We analyze how the strength of SOC in each country shapes the incentives for and outcomes of international monetary policy cooperation. In our framework, monetary policy affects domestic productivity growth via cash-in-advance constraints on both consumption and R&D investment. We show analytically that stronger SOC in either country lowers the optimal cooperative nominal interest rate by increasing R&D-driven growth and cross-border spillovers. Calibrating the model to the U.S. and the Euro Area, we find that the optimal cooperative interest rates satisfy the Friedman rule, while the Nash-equilibrium interest rates are positive in both economies. Moreover, while policy cooperation yields welfare gains for both parties when SOC levels are similar, it generates welfare losses for the country with the weaker SOC when asymmetries are large. Our results highlight a novel mechanism: the feasibility and desirability of international monetary policy cooperation depend critically on the relative strengths of the SOC across countries.
abstract_zh: 本文在纳入资本主义精神（SOC）的两国熊彼特增长模型中研究最优货币政策。我们分析了各国SOC强度如何影响国际货币政策合作的激励与结果。在我们的框架中，货币政策通过消费和研发投资的现金预付约束影响国内生产率增长。我们分析表明，任一国家更强的SOC通过提升研发驱动增长和跨境溢出效应，降低了最优合作名义利率。将模型校准至美国和欧元区，我们发现最优合作利率满足弗里德曼规则，而纳什均衡利率在两国均为正。此外，当SOC水平相似时，政策合作为双方带来福利收益；但当不对称性较大时，合作对SOC较弱的国家产生福利损失。我们的结果突显了一个新颖机制：国际货币政策合作的可行性与可取性关键取决于各国SOC的相对强度。

abstract: We investigate the existence of a middle‐income trap using finite state Markov chains, constant growth thresholds, and mean first passage times. As well as studying output per head, we examine the dynamics of its proximate determinants: total factor productivity (TFP), the capital–output ratio, and human capital. We find upward mobility in the relative capital–output ratio and human capital, but not in relative TFP. The persistence of relative TFP differences, particularly from intermediate income levels, implies slower progression toward frontier income. A middle‐income trap may therefore reflect asymmetric convergence dynamics near the frontier rather than a universal growth slowdown.
abstract_zh: 我们利用有限状态马尔可夫链、恒定增长阈值和平均首次通过时间，研究了中等收入陷阱的存在性。除了考察人均产出外，我们还分析了其直接决定因素的动态变化：全要素生产率（TFP）、资本产出比和人力资本。研究发现，相对资本产出比和人力资本呈现向上流动性，但相对全要素生产率并未如此。相对全要素生产率差异的持续性，尤其是从中等收入水平来看，意味着向前沿收入水平的进展更为缓慢。因此，中等收入陷阱可能反映了靠近前沿水平时的不对称趋同动态，而非普遍的增长放缓。
title: At the threshold: the increasing relevance of the middle‐income trap
title_zh: 在门槛处：中等收入陷阱日益凸显的相关性

abstract: We characterize the spillover effects of helicopter drops and optimal monetary policy in a tractable two‐country overlapping generations model with incomplete markets. As helicopter drops can affect the distribution of income across countries, they create room for redistribution policies which are particularly relevant when agents are heterogeneous and markets are incomplete. Under cooperation, central banks can implement the conditionally Pareto optimal allocation using helicopter drops (and suctions) to “lean against the wind.” In a non‐cooperative setting, helicopter drops exacerbate the incomplete markets' friction by making income more volatile. This paves the way for gains from cooperation.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个可处理的两国世代交叠模型（含不完全市场）中，刻画了直升机撒钱的溢出效应及最优货币政策。由于直升机撒钱可能影响国家间的收入分配，这为再分配政策创造了空间——当经济主体存在异质性且市场不完全时，此类政策尤为重要。在合作框架下，央行可通过直升机撒钱（及抽钱）实施条件帕累托最优配置，实现“逆风干预”。在非合作框架下，直升机撒钱会加剧收入波动，从而放大不完全市场的摩擦，这为合作收益的产生奠定了基础。
title: Helicopter drops in an open economy when markets are incomplete
title_zh: 不完全市场下开放经济中的直升机撒钱

abstract: This paper investigates the asymmetric effects of expansionary and contractionary fiscal shocks in the U.S. economy using a state-of-the-art non-linear local projection framework. To identify fiscal shocks, I use a proxy based on revisions to the mean forecast of government spending growth from the Survey of Professional Forecasters, which represent unexpected changes in expectations about government spending. The estimated fiscal multipliers are larger following positive fiscal shocks than following negative ones, indicating asymmetric effects of fiscal policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 本文运用前沿的非线性局部投影框架，研究了美国经济中扩张性与紧缩性财政冲击的非对称效应。为识别财政冲击，我采用基于专业预测者调查中政府支出增长平均预测修正的代理变量，这些修正反映了对政府支出预期的意外变化。估计结果显示，正向财政冲击后的财政乘数大于负向冲击后的乘数，表明财政政策干预存在非对称效应。
title: News on asymmetric fiscal multipliers
title_zh: 不对称财政乘数新闻

abstract: We analyze infectious diseases in a general equilibrium model with endogenous mobility, where forward-looking agents weigh disease risks against economic opportunities in cross-regional mobility decisions. This generates “self-containment” and “self-healing” mobility responses to regional differences in healthcare and prevalence. Applied to US COVID-19 data, our model reveals that cross-state mobility restrictions curbed infections by reducing cross-regional contacts but increased deaths and output losses by hindering mobility toward regions with better recovery outcomes. Relative to a model with exogenous mobility, our framework predicts fewer infections, lower mortality, and higher economic output following the unanticipated pandemic shock.
abstract_zh: 我们在一个具有内生流动性的一般均衡模型中分析传染病，其中前瞻性主体在跨区域流动决策中权衡疾病风险与经济机会。这产生了对区域医疗保健和患病率差异的“自我隔离”和“自我修复”流动性响应。应用于美国COVID-19数据，我们的模型揭示，跨州流动性限制通过减少跨区域接触遏制了感染，但通过阻碍向恢复结果更好区域的流动增加了死亡和产出损失。相对于具有外生流动性的模型，我们的框架在未预期疫情冲击后预测出更少的感染、更低的死亡率和更高的经济产出。
title: Endogenous mobility in pandemics: Theory and evidence from the United States
title_zh: 大流行中的内生流动性：来自美国的理论与证据

abstract: In evolutionary game theory, when a population of players with the same preferences may freely choose a location in which to interact with other players, previous literature has shown that long-run evolutionary forces select in favor of payoff-dominant equilibria. In this paper, I extend this location choice aspect of evolutionary game theory to the case of two different payoff types of players in 2 × 2 games. I show that whether or not payoff-dominant equilibrium selection occurs depends on the precise interaction of types, especially whether they exhibit mutual strategic homophily or a mix of homophily and heterophily. The former case guarantees payoff-dominant equilibria, and the latter case may not, because coordination becomes imperfect and may settle on an inefficient strategy.
abstract_zh: 在演化博弈论中，当具有相同偏好的玩家群体可以自由选择与其他玩家互动的地点时，既有文献表明，长期演化力量倾向于选择收益占优均衡。本文将演化博弈论中的这一地点选择方面扩展至2×2博弈中两类不同收益类型玩家的情形。我证明，收益占优均衡是否出现取决于类型间的精确互动，尤其是它们是否表现出相互的战略同质性，或是同质性与异质性的混合。前者保证收益占优均衡，而后者则未必，因为协调变得不完美，可能最终停留在低效策略上。
title: Long-Run Efficiency with Local Interactions and Heterogeneous Types
title_zh: 局部互动与异质性类型下的长期效率

abstract: This paper introduces the Euro Area Communication Event-Study Database (EA-CED), a new dataset tracking intraday financial market movements around 304 ECB Governing Council meetings (ECBGC) and 5100 inter-meeting communication (IMC) events by GC members, primarily in the form of speeches and interviews. We document that IMC events are associated with significant market movements often comparable to, or larger than, those following ECB policy announcements, particularly for longer maturity yields. Importantly, these effects are not limited to communication from the ECB President but also from other Governing Council members. Like ECBGC announcements, IMC events convey multidimensional information: three structurally identified factors explain a large share of the yield curve movements around IMC surprises. Finally, we show that IMC events provide relevant information for identifying the effects of monetary policy shocks on euro area output and inflation in a Bayesian Vector Autoregression model.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了欧元区沟通事件研究数据库（EA-CED），这是一个新数据集，追踪了304次欧洲央行管理委员会（ECBGC）会议及5100次由理事会成员进行的会议间沟通（IMC）事件（主要为演讲和访谈形式）期间的日内金融市场变动。我们记录到，IMC事件与显著的市场波动相关联，其幅度往往与欧洲央行政策公告后的波动相当或更大，尤其是在较长到期收益率方面。重要的是，这些影响不仅限于欧洲央行行长的沟通，也来自其他管理委员会成员。与ECBGC公告类似，IMC事件传递了多维信息：三个结构性识别因子解释了IMC意外事件中收益率曲线变动的大部分。最后，我们表明，在贝叶斯向量自回归模型中，IMC事件为识别货币政策冲击对欧元区产出和通胀的影响提供了相关信息。
title: ECB communication and its impact on financial markets
title_zh: 欧洲央行沟通及其对金融市场的影响

abstract: We study how racial hate crimes influence immigrants’ social identity and sense of belonging to the host country. We focus on the 2008 “San Gennaro massacre”, an attack by a Camorra clan against African immigrants in Southern Italy. Using a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach, we show that the event increased the sense of belonging to Italy among Africans living in the affected area, driven by both a ”fear effect” and a ”solidarity effect”. We further document that this shift in social identification spread to other African immigrant communities, particularly those residing in municipalities characterized by a strong presence of organized crime and by a strong local public reaction of solidarity. Finally, we find that this increase in identification with Italy is persistent over time and is not associated with a weakening of ethnic identity.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了种族仇恨犯罪如何影响移民的社会认同感及对东道国的归属感。我们聚焦于2008年的“圣真纳罗大屠杀”，这是一起卡莫拉犯罪家族对意大利南部非洲移民发动的袭击。采用双重差分法（DiD），我们表明该事件增强了受影响地区非洲裔居民对意大利的归属感，这一效应由“恐惧效应”和“团结效应”共同驱动。我们进一步记录到，这种社会认同的转变扩散到了其他非洲移民社区，尤其是那些居住在组织犯罪活动猖獗且当地公众团结反应强烈的市镇的社区。最后，我们发现这种对意大利认同感的增强随时间持续存在，且并未伴随族裔认同的减弱。
title: Immigrants’ social identity, racial hate crimes, and public backlash: Evidence from the ”San Gennaro massacre”
title_zh: 移民社会身份、种族仇恨犯罪与公众反弹：来自“圣热纳罗大屠杀”的证据

abstract: We develop a dynamic macroeconomic model with heterogeneous households, endogenous fertility, and endogenous labor market participation to study the two-way interactions between demographic change and economic growth. The model yields closed-form results in a simplified setting and is then calibrated to Japanese data from 1970 to 2019 to examine long-run trends and policy counterfactuals. We find that reducing participation costs increases employment but lowers GDP per worker and total population due to a negative spillover that increases childrearing costs; lowering the cost of raising children slows population decline but reduces GDP per capita mostly by expanding the non-working population; and faster productivity growth boosts GDP per capita and population growth, but reduces labor force participation through selection effects. Overall, fertility and labor market policies involve trade-offs—between participation and productivity or between growth and demographic stability. These trade-offs are mitigated by technological progress, which tends to enhance both economic and demographic outcomes; participation may decline via composition effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性家庭、内生生育率和内生劳动参与率的动态宏观经济模型，以研究人口结构变化与经济增长之间的双向互动。该模型在简化设定下得出闭式解，并随后基于1970年至2019年的日本数据进行校准，以考察长期趋势和政策反事实分析。我们发现，降低参与成本会增加就业，但由于负向溢出效应提高了育儿成本，从而降低了人均GDP和总人口；降低抚养子女的成本会减缓人口下降，但主要通过扩大非劳动人口规模而降低人均GDP；更快的生产率增长提升了人均GDP和人口增长率，但通过选择效应降低了劳动参与率。总体而言，生育和劳动力市场政策涉及权衡——在参与率与生产率之间，或在增长与人口稳定性之间。这些权衡可通过技术进步得到缓解，技术进步往往同时改善经济与人口结果；但参与率可能因构成效应而下降。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Fertility, labor market participation, and macroeconomic dynamics
title_zh: 生育率、劳动力市场参与和宏观经济动态

abstract: This study examines the relationship between educational attainment and occupations in Italy, focusing on how education aligns with job categories and how this relationship evolves over time. Using Labour Force Survey data, we construct education–occupation matrices for 2014, 2019, and 2024, providing a detailed view of changes in the joint distribution of workers across education and occupations. We introduce a theoretical model in which each education–occupation combination is treated as a labour sub-market, and employment levels result from equilibrium between labour supply and demand. The model provides a structural benchmark to assess whether observed changes can be explained by standard market mechanisms. Comparing observed and predicted matrices over the periods 2014–2019 and 2019–2024, we identify non-negligible deviations from benchmark-consistent reallocation. These deviations are interpreted as signals consistent with structural change in the labour market, potentially reflecting technological developments, institutional factors, or shifts in educational supply. The framework is intended as a diagnostic tool rather than a causal test: deviations between predicted and observed allocations signal unexplained reallocation patterns rather than provide direct evidence on specific underlying mechanisms.
title: How education matches occupation: modelling the structure of skill-job alignment
title_zh: 教育如何匹配职业：技能-职位匹配结构的建模

abstract: Political agency models predict that officials with higher continuation values of office exert greater effort when observable performance is tied to career rewards. We test this prediction in China’s top-down cadre system, where the 2012 leadership reshuffle following the 18th Chinese Communist Party Congress coincided with the elevation of PM2.5 reduction to an explicit cadre-evaluation criterion. Using data from Chinese prefecture-level cities between 2008 and 2015, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing cities led by first-term and reappointed leaders. We find that post-2012, first-term leaders achieved larger PM2.5 reductions than reappointed leaders. This gap reflects first-term leaders’ longer career horizons and weaker pre-existing capture relationships with incumbent polluters. Consistent with multitask incentive theory, first-term leaders exert greater effort on measurable, fast-acting administrative instruments such as production restrictions, while green subsidies and technological innovation show no significant term-stage difference. The paper provides new evidence on political agency, regulatory capture, and multitask incentives in top-down bureaucratic systems.
abstract_zh: 政治代理模型预测，当可观测的绩效与职业回报挂钩时，拥有更高任职延续价值的官员会付出更多努力。我们在中国自上而下的干部体系中检验了这一预测，该体系中2012年第十八届中国共产党全国代表大会后的领导层换届恰逢PM2.5减排被明确纳入干部考核标准。利用2008年至2015年间中国地级市的数据，我们采用双重差分设计，比较首任与连任领导所在城市的表现。研究发现，2012年后，首任领导所在城市的PM2.5降幅大于连任领导所在城市。这一差距反映了首任领导更长的职业前景以及与现有污染企业之间较弱的既有俘获关系。与多任务激励理论一致，首任领导在可衡量、见效快的行政手段（如生产限制）上投入更多努力，而绿色补贴和技术创新方面则未显示出显著的任期阶段差异。本文为自上而下官僚体系中的政治代理、监管俘获及多任务激励提供了新的证据。

title: New brooms sweep cleaner? political term and air pollution governance
title_zh: 新扫帚扫得更干净？政治任期与空气污染治理

abstract: Urban green infrastructure (UGI) provides a vital nature-based solution for enhancing sustainability in arid cities, yet its adoption in formal planning frameworks remains limited. This study examines the spatial distribution, equity, and planning implications of UGI in Al Ain, UAE, a rapidly expanding inland desert city. Using ultra-high-resolution (9-cm) aerial imagery and 1-m LiDAR data, we applied a support vector machine (SVM) classifier to produce a detailed land-cover map with an overall accuracy of 90.2% and a three-dimensional assessment of vegetation volume. UGI covers 16.64% (40.76 km²) of the urban extent, providing a relatively high per-capita green space provision of 62.14 m². Despite this, spatial analysis reveals pronounced inequities, with vegetated areas clustering in historic, oasis-adjacent neighborhoods, while newer high-density districts emerge as “cold spots” with minimal vegetation. Current municipal planning regulations, which prioritize built density and visual landscaping over ecological functionality, exacerbate these disparities. Integrating volumetric vegetation metrics and per-capita thresholds into planning codes can improve spatial equity, strengthen ecosystem services, and mitigate urban heat island effects. This study advances performance-based urban planning in arid environments and demonstrates the potential of high-resolution geospatial methods to guide sustainable, equitable urban development.
abstract_zh: 城市绿色基础设施（UGI）为提升干旱城市可持续性提供了重要的基于自然的解决方案，然而其在正式规划框架中的采纳仍十分有限。本研究考察了阿联酋艾因市（Al Ain）这一快速扩张的内陆沙漠城市中UGI的空间分布、公平性及规划启示。利用超高分辨率（9厘米）航空影像和1米激光雷达数据，我们应用支持向量机（SVM）分类器生成了总体精度达90.2%的详细土地覆盖图，并对植被体积进行了三维评估。UGI覆盖城市建成区的16.64%（40.76平方公里），提供了相对较高的人均绿地供给，达62.14平方米。尽管如此，空间分析揭示了显著的不平等现象：植被区域集中于历史悠久的绿洲邻近街区，而新兴的高密度区域则成为植被极少的“冷点”。现行市政规划法规优先考虑建筑密度和视觉景观美化，而非生态功能，进一步加剧了这些差异。将体积化植被指标和人均阈值纳入规划规范，可改善空间公平性、强化生态系统服务，并缓解城市热岛效应。本研究推进了干旱环境下的绩效导向型城市规划，并展示了高分辨率地理空间方法在引导可持续、公平城市发展方面的潜力。
title: Beyond surface area: Integrating volumetric green infrastructure into planning regulations to enhance equity and sustainability in an arid city
title_zh: 超越表面积：将立体绿色基础设施纳入规划法规以提升干旱城市的公平性与可持续性

abstract: This study expands the framework for analyzing the interplay of agricultural area and crop diversity on agroecosystem services by incorporating the species‐area relationship concept from biology. We estimate panel fixed effects models that include both agricultural area and crop diversity, along with their interaction term. This approach allows us to derive a crop diversity threshold‐the point at which agricultural land no longer exerts a negative marginal effect on water quality, driven by adjustments along the intensive margin rather than the extensive margin. By replicating well‐established water quality models from the literature and conducting robustness checks, we validate this framework. Our results empirically demonstrate that crop diversity can mitigate the adverse impact of agricultural land on water quality, aligning with the goals of conservation programs. This framework provides a more comprehensive understanding of agriculture's non‐unidirectional contributions to water quality, rather than only negative impacts, which are pervasive in the literature. Moreover, the thresholds identified in this study provide valuable insights for prioritizing regions for landscape‐based, crop diversity‐driven conservation strategies and policy design.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过引入生物学中的物种-面积关系概念，拓展了分析农业面积与作物多样性对农业生态系统服务交互作用的框架。我们估计了包含农业面积、作物多样性及其交互项的面板固定效应模型。这一方法使我们能够推导出作物多样性阈值——即农业用地通过集约边际调整而非粗放边际调整，不再对水质产生负面边际效应的临界点。通过复现文献中成熟的水质模型并进行稳健性检验，我们验证了这一框架的有效性。实证结果表明，作物多样性能够缓解农业用地对水质的负面影响，这与保护项目的目标一致。该框架有助于更全面地理解农业对水质的非单向贡献（而非文献中普遍强调的单一负面影响）。此外，本研究识别的阈值可为优先区域划定提供依据，助力基于景观格局、以作物多样性为导向的保护策略与政策设计。
title: Interplay of crop diversity and agricultural area in agroecosystem services: Analytical and empirical study on local water quality
title_zh: 作物多样性与农业面积在农业生态系统服务中的相互作用：基于地方水质的分析与实证研究

abstract: Shortly after major policy changes to US science funding began in early 2025, we surveyed 916 young biomedical scientists – PhD students and postdoctoral researchers – about their career intentions and expectations. The results document a dramatic shift in sentiment. Barely half of respondents now say they are likely to remain in academia, down 22 percentage points from how they felt six months earlier. The fraction likely to stay in the United States fell by 21 percentage points. Even satisfaction with having pursued a PhD in science declined by 16 percentage points. These are not the complaints of established scientists defending their budgets, but rather the stated intentions of the next generation – the scientists who would, in ordinary times, become the principal investigators of the future.
abstract_zh: 2025年初美国科研经费重大政策调整后不久，我们针对916名青年生物医学科学家（博士生和博士后研究人员）开展了职业意向与预期调查。结果显示科研人员心态发生显著转变：目前仅半数受访者表示可能留在学术界，较六个月前下降22个百分点；可能留在美国工作的比例下降21个百分点；甚至对攻读科学博士学位的满意度也下降16个百分点。这并非资深科学家为维护预算而发出的抱怨，而是下一代科研工作者——在正常情况下本应成为未来首席研究员的群体——明确表达的职业规划。
title: Before the Exodus? Young Scientists and the Future of US Science
title_zh: 出走之前？青年科学家与美国科学的未来

abstract: Solar Radiation Modification (SRM) has been proposed as a potential tool to limit increases in global or regional temperatures caused by anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions. While previous research has extensively examined the climate system’s response to various SRM strategies, as well as their aggregate economic consequences, the regional distribution of economic impacts has received less attention. In this study, we use NorESM2–DIAM—an Earth System Model coupled to a high-resolution integrated assessment model—to assess the economic impacts, measured in GDP per capita, in an idealised SRM scenario where incoming solar radiation is reduced by 1%. Our results suggest that, relative to a baseline without SRM, most countries experience economic gains under SRM, with only a few countries facing negative impacts. Low-income countries tend to see the largest benefits, reducing global economic inequality relative to the baseline. However, reduced damages and lower inequality are accompanied by higher emissions under SRM, potentially leading to additional adverse effects not captured here. These findings highlight potential trade-offs between economic benefits, reduced inequality, and increased emissions relevant for SRM governance.
abstract_zh: 太阳辐射管理（SRM）已被提出作为限制人为温室气体排放导致全球或区域气温升高的潜在工具。尽管已有研究广泛探讨了气候系统对不同SRM策略的响应及其总体经济后果，但经济影响的区域分布问题受到的关注较少。本研究利用耦合高分辨率综合评估模型的地球系统模型NorESM2–DIAM，评估了在理想化SRM情景（入射太阳辐射减少1%）下以人均GDP衡量的经济影响。结果表明：与未实施SRM的基准情景相比，大多数国家在SRM下获得经济收益，仅少数国家面临负面影响。低收入国家往往获得最大收益，从而降低了相对于基准情景的全球经济不平等。然而，SRM在减少损害和降低不平等的同时，也伴随着更高的排放量，可能引发本研究未涵盖的额外不利影响。这些发现揭示了SRM治理中经济收益、不平等减少与排放增加之间的潜在权衡关系。
title: Regional Economic Impacts and Emission Responses under Solar Radiation Modification
title_zh: 太阳辐射干预下的区域经济影响与排放响应

abstract: A foundational question in General Equilibrium theory—when is an equilibrium stable?—has remained largely unresolved for over 150 years despite important contributions. This paper proposes a resolution.
abstract_zh: 一般均衡理论中的一个基础性问题——均衡何时是稳定的？——尽管已有重要贡献，但在超过150年的时间里仍未得到根本解决。本文提出了一种解决方案。
title: Tatonnement and Price Setting in General Equilibrium
title_zh: 一般均衡中的试探过程与价格设定

abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of 82 randomized controlled trials across more than 20 countries to estimate the effects of low-cost, remote parental engagement interventions delivered through text messages, phone calls, and apps. We estimate a joint likelihood function that incorporates both written studies and unwritten studies identified through trial registries, funder records, research labs, evidence clearinghouses, and other sources. By also recording sample sizes for unwritten studies, the model estimates the distribution of standard errors, identifies write-up probabilities conditional on significance, and characterizes the file drawer by estimating effect distributions for written and unwritten studies. Bias-corrected effects are 0.05 SD for test scores, 0.07 SD for grades, 0.05 SD for attendance, and 0.03 SD for enrollment. In the best-identified domain, test scores, statistically insignificant results are still written up at high rates. We also find that larger studies tend to estimate smaller latent effects, which could indicate that true effects are correlated with study precision, violating a common meta-analysis assumption. In smaller-sample domains, our approach helps identify selection probabilities by anchoring the absolute write-up rates. Finally, we estimate the value of additional RCTs to inform adoption decisions. Any single study estimate is unlikely to dissuade adoption because parent interventions have high marginal value of public funds. Instead, future research is most valuable when it can explain heterogeneity across settings.
abstract_zh: 我们对来自20多个国家的82项随机对照试验进行了元分析，以评估通过短信、电话和应用程序实施的低成本、远程家长参与干预措施的效果。我们构建了一个联合似然函数，该函数整合了已发表研究以及通过试验注册库、资助方记录、研究实验室、证据数据库及其他来源识别的未发表研究。通过同时记录未发表研究的样本量，该模型估计了标准误的分布，识别了基于显著性的撰写概率，并通过估计已发表与未发表研究的效果分布来刻画文件抽屉效应。经偏差校正后的效果为：考试成绩0.05个标准差、学业成绩0.07个标准差、出勤率0.05个标准差、入学率0.03个标准差。在识别效果最佳的考试成绩领域，统计不显著的结果仍以较高比例被撰写发表。我们还发现，样本量较大的研究倾向于估计出更小的潜在效应，这可能表明真实效应与研究精度存在相关性，从而违反了元分析中的常见假设。在样本量较小的领域，我们的方法通过锚定绝对撰写率来帮助识别选择概率。最后，我们估算了额外随机对照试验的价值，以指导采纳决策。由于家长干预措施具有较高的公共资金边际价值，任何单一研究估计值都不太可能阻止其被采纳。相反，当未来研究能够解释不同情境下的异质性时，其价值最为显著。
title: Characterizing the File Drawer: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis of Parent-Interventions Around the World
title_zh: 描述文件抽屉：基于全球家长干预元分析的证据

abstract: Scaling up effective policies often requires the attention of frontline bureaucrats with many competing responsibilities. Even when policymakers adopt effective programs, implementation may not follow. In a nationwide experiment in the Dominican Republic, we test interventions to increase school principals' implementation of an educational program proven effective in a previous RCT. Only 37% of control schools verifiably implemented the intervention when ordered to by the Ministry of Education, compared with 83% in the original trial. Implementation was no higher among schools that previously implemented the program in the RCT, suggesting that fixed costs of adoption do not explain non-adoption. We find precise null effects of sharing research evidence, providing modest financial incentives, or offering implementation assistance to principals. In contrast, additional reminder calls increased implementation by 20 percentage points. A second experiment targeting a different mandated program yields the same pattern: reminders produce large effects, while monitoring messages have smaller effects. Our findings point to limited attention among bureaucrats as an important barrier to scaling policies.
abstract_zh: 扩大有效政策的实施规模，往往需要一线行政人员投入精力，而他们通常身兼多项职责。即使政策制定者采纳了有效的项目，执行也可能无法跟进。在多米尼加共和国的一项全国性实验中，我们测试了旨在提高校长执行一项经先前随机对照试验（RCT）证明有效的教育项目的干预措施。当教育部下令实施时，对照组学校中仅有37%可验证地执行了该干预措施，而原始试验中这一比例为83%。在先前RCT中已执行该项目的学校中，实施率并未更高，这表明采纳的固定成本并不能解释未采纳现象。我们发现，分享研究证据、提供适度经济激励或向校长提供实施支持均产生精确的零效应。相比之下，额外的提醒电话使实施率提高了20个百分点。针对另一项强制性项目的第二项实验得出了相同模式：提醒产生显著效果，而监控信息的效果较小。我们的研究结果表明，行政人员注意力有限是政策规模化推广的重要障碍。
title: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up
title_zh: 激励、证据与对官僚的提醒：克服政策推广的障碍
